meta.name: ecommerce-full-pipeline
meta.description: 电商运营在开展跨境电商或闲鱼捡漏业务时，若需解决选品难、上架繁琐等痛点，必用此技能！一键打通“爆品挖掘→1688采集→多平台上架→推广文案→短视频生成”全自动流水线，轻松实现端到端自动化，让开店运营效率翻倍。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成从爆品挖掘到上架推广的电商全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做跨境电商或闲鱼捡漏，想省掉选品上架的繁琐
copy.tagline_en: Automate the full ecommerce flow from product discovery to listing and promotion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do cross-border or Xianyu sales and want to skip manual listing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能按你的关键词跑电商流水线：从 1688 采集商品、清洗数据、生成上架模板、写推广文案、合成竖屏短视频，也能搜闲鱼捡漏、监控价格。
howto.when: 当你提出跨境电商选品、上架、推广等需求，或要做闲鱼二手捡漏时触发；需 Python 3.8+，1688 与闲鱼完整采集要已登录的浏览器。

say.text: 帮我采集 1688 的蓝牙耳机，清洗后生成全平台上架模板
搜闲鱼 999 元以内的 4K 投影仪，挑出值得捡漏的

say.text: 用这些商品图做 5 条 15 秒竖屏推广视频

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can run an e-commerce pipeline from your keywords: scrape 1688 items, clean data, build Shopify/TikTok listing templates, write ad copy, render vertical videos, plus Xianyu bargain search and price monitoring.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for cross-border e-commerce selection, listing, promotion or Xianyu second-hand bargain hunting. Needs Python 3.8+; full 1688/Xianyu scraping needs a logged-in browser.

say_en.text: Scrape 1688 for Bluetooth earbuds, clean data, build all-platform listings
Find Xianyu 4K projectors under 999 and pick the best bargains
Turn these product photos into five 15-second vertical promo videos
